title: Accidentally Climbed a Mountain in Marseille
description: The sea in Marseille was absolutely beautiful, but the hike nearly killed me.
coverAlt: White limestone cliffs and pine trees surrounding a calm blue inlet in the Calanques near Marseille

images.alt: White limestone cliffs and sculpted rock pinnacles covered with pine trees above a sheltered Mediterranean inlet in the Calanques
images.caption: Calanque de Sugiton is beautiful! Just don't get adventurous and wander off-trail like I did. I nearly died :(

images.alt: Orange sun setting over the Mediterranean as swimmers and beachgoers gather along a busy Marseille beach
images.caption: One last swim while the sun dropped into the Mediterranean.
